description: This header file declares functions related to vehicle speed measurement and control, including retrieval, initialization, mocking, and sensor status checks.

methods.name: getVehicleSpeed
methods.description: Returns the current vehicle speed in kilometers per hour.

methods.name: initVehicleSpeed
methods.description: Initializes the vehicle speed measurement system, with a logger.

methods.name: setMockVehicleSpeed
methods.description: Sets a mock vehicle speed value, possibly for testing.

methods.name: hasVehicleSpeedSensor
methods.description: Checks if the vehicle speed sensor is present and functional.

methods.name: stopVSSPins
methods.description: Stops the vehicle speed sensor pins, possibly disabling hardware.

methods.name: startVSSPins
methods.description: Starts the vehicle speed sensor pins, enabling hardware.
